items.summary: Building a pre-launch AI-native product across Flutter, Supabase, UX/UI, Figma design systems, data modeling, product assets and structured AI workflows.

Model decision flows around user context, constraints, structured AI output and mobile UI actions.

items.summary: Redesigned and developed production Flutter GPS tracking apps from Figma to store release as the sole mobile/frontend owner.

Integrated WebSockets, custom backend auth/push, biometric auth, offline sync and store releases.
